domain: Query is missing: machine or station ID, time period
Agent must NOT assume a default machine or time period and proceed
Agent must ask: which machine or station, and over what time period
Agent may list examples of valid machine IDs to help the user (e.g., STP-01-PRS-HYP01, WLD-01-UBD)

ground_truth.expected_behavior: Asks for machine/station and time period before retrieving any data — does not guess or return failure rate for an arbitrary machine

domain: Query is missing: machine ID, PM type (preventive/corrective/predictive), scheduled date
Agent must NOT create a work order with assumed values
Agent must ask: which machine, what type of PM, and when
Agent may ask if the user wants to check maintenance history first to determine the right interval

ground_truth.expected_behavior: Asks for machine ID, PM type, and date before calling any tools — does not create a work order with assumed values

domain: Query is missing: which station or stage, which quality metric (Cpk, defect rate, FPY), time period
Agent must NOT pick a station or metric arbitrarily and run the analysis
Agent must ask: which station or stage, which metric to evaluate
Agent may offer to run a factory-wide OEE quality component summary if the user wants a broad overview

required_clarifications: Which quality metric (Cpk, defect rate, FPY)?
ground_truth.expected_behavior: Asks which station and metric to evaluate — does not run analysis for an arbitrarily chosen station

domain: Query is missing: what change to evaluate, what date the change occurred, which metric to compare, which station or machine
Agent must NOT assume a recent change or default metric
Agent must ask: what change was made, on what date, and which metric to compare

required_clarifications: What date did the change occur?
Which metric to compare (Cpk, defect rate, MTTR, OEE)?
ground_truth.expected_behavior: Asks for the change description, change date, and metric before calling compare_periods — does not assume a recent change

domain: Query is missing: which issue or problem to document, which station or machine, what the defect or failure was
Agent must NOT create an 8D report with fabricated or assumed issue details
Agent must ask: what problem is the 8D for, which station or machine is involved
Agent may ask if there is an existing issue record (e.g., ISSUE-2025-001) or failure ID to reference

required_clarifications: What problem or issue is the 8D documenting?
Which station or machine is involved?
ground_truth.expected_behavior: Asks for the problem description and affected station/machine before starting the 8D — does not generate report with assumed content

domain: Query is missing: which station or stage, which time period
Agent must NOT return OEE for an arbitrary station or default to the most recent period without asking
Agent must ask: which station or stage, and for what period
Agent may offer to return a factory-wide OEE summary across all 5 stages if the user wants an overview

ground_truth.expected_behavior: Asks which station/stage and time period — offers factory-wide summary as an alternative if user wants a broad view

domain: Agent has no memory of prior sessions or a configured 'usual report'
Agent must NOT fabricate or guess what 'usual' means
Agent must ask the user to specify what report they want
Agent may list available report types: OEE summary, defect rate by station, MTBF/MTTR, Cpk trend, supplier scorecard

required_clarifications: What report are you referring to? No default report is configured.
Which data or metrics should the report cover?
ground_truth.expected_behavior: Clarifies that no 'usual report' is configured — asks the user to specify what data to include, lists available report types
